btpConfigYaml:
global_account:
  subdomain: acme-3pl-prod
  guid: "<SET_VIA_KEY_VAULT>"
  display_name: Acme 3PL Production

subaccount:
  guid: "<SET_VIA_KEY_VAULT>"
  subdomain: acme-3pl-de
  region: eu10
  display_name: Acme 3PL - Germany

cloud_foundry:
  api_endpoint: https://api.cf.eu10.hana.ondemand.com
  org_name: acme-3pl-de
  org_guid: "<SET_VIA_KEY_VAULT>"
  default_space: dev
  region: eu10

endpoints:
  accounts_service: https://accounts-service.cfapps.eu10.hana.ondemand.com
  entitlements_service: https://entitlements-service.cfapps.eu10.hana.ondemand.com
  provisioning_service: https://provisioning-service.cfapps.eu10.hana.ondemand.com
  xsuaa_api: https://acme-3pl-de.authentication.eu10.hana.ondemand.com
  xsuaa_subaccount_api: https://acme-3pl-de.authentication.eu10.hana.ondemand.com

auth:
  cis_central:
    client_id_env: "<SET_VIA_KEY_VAULT>"
    client_secret_env: "<SET_VIA_KEY_VAULT>"
    token_url: https://acme-3pl-de-ga.authentication.eu10.hana.ondemand.com/oauth/token
    grant_type: client_credentials
  xsuaa:
    client_id_env: "<SET_VIA_KEY_VAULT>"
    client_secret_env: "<SET_VIA_KEY_VAULT>"
    token_url: https://acme-3pl-de.authentication.eu10.hana.ondemand.com/oauth/token
    grant_type: client_credentials

api_paths:
  accounts: /accounts/v1
  entitlements: /entitlements/v1
  provisioning: /provisioning/v1
  authorization: /sap/rest/authorization/v2

defaults:
  timeout_seconds: 30
  retry_attempts: 3
  retry_delay_seconds: 2
  output_format: table
  page_size: 100

entitlements:
  - service: cloudfoundry
    plan: standard
  - service: destination
    plan: lite
manifestYaml:
applications:
- name: acme-3pl-de-api
  memory: 256M
  instances: 1
  buildpacks:
  - python_buildpack
  command: gunicorn app:app --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers 2
  metadata:
    annotations:
      description: "Acme 3PL (DE) integration API on BTP Cloud Foundry"
  env:
    APP_NAME: acme-3pl-de-api
    APP_ENV: production
summaryForApproval: Creates a new BTP subaccount for Acme Corp (DE, eu10) with Cloud Foundry + destination entitlements, plus a Cloud Foundry app deployment (acme-3pl-de-api, Flask/gunicorn, 256M). Credentials are masked pending Key Vault setup.
